## Core Capabilities & Services
1. **Custom Website Design & Development**: Modern, high-performance websites built with React, Vite, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS.
2. **E-Commerce Development**: Conversion-optimized online stores with secure payment gateway integrations (UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Razorpay, Stripe).
3. **Website Redesign & Speed Optimization**: Sub-second loading speed, 95+ Google PageSpeed score optimization, and UX audits.
4. **Search Engine & Generative Engine Optimization (SEO & GEO)**: Technical SEO, structured data (JSON-LD), local search ranking, and AI search visibility.
5. **Website Maintenance & Support**: 24/7 uptime monitoring, security patching, monthly content updates, and cloud backups.
